question: What locative claim is made about the wind-filling air with respect to all beings?
premises: There is an air characterized as wind-filling.
That air is present in all beings.
It is said to be situated there.
inference: The wind-filling air is situated in all beings.
uncertainties: Relation between this air and Haṃsa not stated here
plain_english: The wind-filling air is situated in all beings.
